name: Water Body
description: In a white gallery the figure turns into a statue of clear moving water, then pours down into a spreading pool.

wardrobe.man: a loose white linen shirt and light grey linen trousers, barefoot
wardrobe.woman: a loose white linen shirt and light grey linen trousers, barefoot
wardrobe.person: a loose white linen shirt and light grey linen trousers, barefoot

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. {references} The {subject} is the only person in the new still, with exactly {their} face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline, hairstyle, hair colour{facial_hair}, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. The clothing, the place and the light come only from this description. The {subject} stands barefoot in the middle of a bright empty white gallery with a polished pale grey concrete floor, facing the camera, wearing {wardrobe}, arms relaxed at the sides. Tall white walls, a large skylight pouring soft daylight from above, and a faint reflection of the {subject} on the floor. Medium-wide shot at eye level from six metres away, the {subject} centered, full body visible, plenty of empty floor around {them}. Cinematic photography, soft top light, clean airy tones. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, bare white walls throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} ALREADY stands still in the middle of the gallery, feet planted on the same spot for the whole shot, eyes on a point just past the camera. The skin and the clothes turn into clear moving water from the chest outward, until the {subject} is a standing statue of transparent rippling water in {their} exact shape, the face still readable, light refracting through the body and bright caustics dancing on the floor. Then the water statue loses its shape from the top down and pours straight down onto the floor around the feet, spreading outward in a wide shining puddle that runs toward the camera, until by the last second only the rippling puddle remains on the spot where the {subject} stood. The camera holds a steady medium-wide shot. Sound: a gurgling rush of water, a heavy pouring splash, water spreading across concrete, the echo of the empty gallery. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, water simulation with real refraction, caustics and splash physics, sharp detail, stable picture.
generic_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} in the frame stays on the same spot. The skin and the clothes turn into clear moving water, until the {subject} is a standing statue of transparent rippling water in {their} exact shape, light refracting through it. Then the water statue loses its shape from the top down and pours straight down to the ground, spreading into a wide shining puddle where the {subject} stood. The camera keeps the same framing and the same movement it already has. Sound: a gurgling rush of water, a heavy pouring splash. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, water simulation with real refraction and splash physics, sharp detail, stable picture.
